task: Prepare native emitter and Fast Debug execution for take(place) and construct regression fixtures and harness.
observation: The closed set of four terminal field types (option, Vector, Map, Queue) in the LOL proposal maps directly to Rust Default and std::mem::take(&mut place), enabling zero-clone, in-place move lowering without element duplication or reallocation. In Fast Debug, locate_tree_node provides single-evaluation place resolution, preventing duplicate evaluation of nested projection indices. Authored 7 dedicated fixtures and an explicit regression harness tracking the feature-pending checker boundary without false failures.
impact: Establishes concrete consumer integration architecture and verification gates for take(place) ahead of Team A's W01 handoff, preventing idle delay and ensuring strict checker semantic authority.

resolution.summary: Completed technical design and lowering architecture in TEAM_B_R3_TAKE_PREPARATION.md, 7 take execution fixtures, and regression test harness verify_take_fixtures.py.
